name: pi-zhipu-usage
description: Pi extension: show GLM Coding Plan usage and reset countdown in the footer. Supports Zhipu domestic (open.bigmodel.cn), international (api.z.ai), local proxy / Headroom setups, and @zigai/pi-footer slot integration.
